newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

*   **[Biotech]** **Estuary Biotherapeutics launches with $93M for kidney disease gene therapy** — *BioPharma Dive* [Link](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/estuary-kidney-disease-gene-therapy-launch-emerged-biogen-biotech-startup/833114/)
    *   Launched out of stealth with backing from former Biogen leaders, built on Yale research by Stefan Somlo and Michael Caplan regarding autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease.
    *   Preclinical work demonstrates that reactivating polycystins or delivering a small piece of the full polycystin protein shrinks cysts, reverses inflammation, and reduces scarring.
*   **Cultural adaptation in mental health burden metrics** — *The Lancet* [Link](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01850-7/fulltext?rss=yes)
    *   Authors of the Global Burden of Diseases, Injuries, and Risk Factors Study (GBD) 2023 defended their methodology regarding mental disorder prevalence, emphasizing that uncertain burden estimates across populations are preferable to having no estimates at all.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

*   **[Biotech]** **Verastem advances KRAS inhibitor in advanced solid tumors** — *STAT* [Link](https://www.STATnews.com/2026/10/15/biotech-news-verastem-kras-inhibitor-shows-promise-in-pancreatic-cancer/)
    *   Verastem Oncology reported encouraging early results for its KRAS G12D inhibitor studied in over 200 patients with advanced solid tumors, including metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and non-small cell lung cancer.
*   **[Biotech]** **Phase 1 trial of D2C7-ATC in recurrent malignant glioma** — *Nature Medicine* [Link](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04715-w)
    *   Results from a Phase 1 trial of the antibody-toxin conjugate D2C7-ATC targeting EGFR and EGFRvIII showed an encouraging safety and efficacy profile.
    *   Translational analyses of patient samples indicated both intratumoral and systemic immune activation.
*   **[Biotech]** **Protagonist Therapeutics completes Phase 2b dose confirmation enrollment** — *BioStocks* [Link](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2110703213376929867)
    *   Completed enrollment of the Phase 2b open-label dose confirmation phase for the THRIVE-3 registrational trial evaluating intravenous choline chloride in patients on parenteral support.
    *   Interim data readout is anticipated in Q4 2026.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

*   **[Biotech]** **Vagus nerve stimulation demonstrates 3-year durability in RECOVER trial** — *BioRxiv* [Link](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.31.26358854)
    *   The RECOVER study evaluated 436 participants with markedly treatment-resistant depression randomized to three years of active VNS or one year of sham followed by two years of active VNS.
    *   The Early-Active group demonstrated greater odds of improvement during the RCT phase (OR=1.66, p=0.005), with improvements gradually converging towards parity by month 36 following activation in the delayed arm.
*   **Sacituzumab tirumotecan combination improves PFS in advanced NSCLC** — *The Lancet* [Link](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01672-7/fulltext?rss=yes)
    *   In the phase 3 OptiTROP-Lung05 trial, sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) plus pembrolizumab significantly improved progression-free survival compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy (median not reached vs 5.7 months; hazard ratio 0.35, 95% CI 0.26–0.47) in PD-L1-positive advanced NSCLC (TPS ≥1%).
    *   Correspondence noted that the study was not designed to establish superiority over standard chemoimmunotherapy, which remains the preferred frontline choice for patients with a TPS of 1–49%.
*   **[Big Pharma]** **Correction issued for ACHIEVE-4 Phase 3 trial appendix** — *The Lancet* [Link](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)02055-6/fulltext?rss=yes)
    *   An appendix correction was published for the Phase 3, event-driven, randomised, open-label ACHIEVE-4 trial evaluating the cardiovascular safety of orforglipron versus insulin glargine in type 2 diabetes patients at increased cardiovascular risk.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

*   **FDA launches Rare Disease Framework Initiative** — *BioPharma Dive* [Link](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/fda-rare-disease-framework-initiative-drug-development/833080/)
    *   The FDA announced plans to reimagine rare disease drug regulation by applying disease-specific standards instead of a one-size-fits-all approach.
    *   The agency aims to solicit feedback at an Oct 28 meeting and target initial recommendations by February.
*   **FDA issues health fraud warning for sexual enhancement product containing sildenafil** — *FDA* [Link](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/medication-health-fraud-notifications/10-day-forecast-may-be-harmful-due-hidden-ingredients)
    *   The FDA advised consumers against purchasing "10 Day Forecast" after laboratory analysis confirmed unlisted sildenafil and acetaminophen.
    *   The hidden phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor poses severe risks of dangerous blood pressure drops when combined with nitrates, particularly in patients with cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or hypertension.
*   **FDA highlights Bayesian methodology and generic drug modeling in regulatory updates** — *FDA* [Link](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/navigating-fda-bayesian-draft-guidance-design-analysis-and-review-considerations-10142026)
    *   The agency highlighted implementation details of the January 2026 draft guidance on utilizing Bayesian methodologies in drug and biological product clinical trials.
    *   Additional recent workshops addressed Model-Integrated Evidence (MIE) and modernizing bioequivalence approaches for topical, transdermal, and generic drug development.
*   **[Biotech]** **Fractyl Health plans De Novo submission for Revita** — *BioStocks* [Link](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2111052186994053469)
    *   Following study data readouts, the company intends to initiate a De Novo marketing application with the FDA in late Q4 2026 for Revita in post-GLP-1 weight maintenance, with 12-month results expected in Q1 2027.

5. **Business & Strategy**

*   **[Biotech]** **City Therapeutics prices $200M IPO for next-gen RNAi pipeline** — *BioPharma Dive* [Link](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/city-therapeutics-ipo-price-rnai-drugs/832945/)
    *   Co-founded by former Alnylam CEO John Maraganore, City Therapeutics secured $200 million by selling 11.1 million shares at $18 apiece on Nasdaq under the ticker CTY.
    *   The company is advancing RNA interference therapies designed to target common conditions and expand beyond the liver into new tissue types like the brain and lungs.
*   **[Biotech]** **Armed Cell Therapeutics acquires Galapagos CAR-T assets** — *BioPharma Dive* [Link](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lakefront-armed-cell-therapies-deal-stoffels-galapagos/833082/)
    *   Belgian startup Armed Cell Therapeutics, chaired by Paul Stoffels, acquired cancer cell therapy assets from Lakefront Biotherapeutics (formerly Galapagos) for 8 million euros upfront and up to $230 million in milestones.
    *   The deal includes two armed CAR-T therapies nearing human testing for non-Hodgkin lymphoma and small cell lung cancer, plus three preclinical projects.
*   **[Biotech]** **Voyager Therapeutics receives coverage initiation from UBS** — *BioStocks* [Link](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2110712414429921775)
    *   Assumed with a Buy rating and a price target of $48 at UBS.
*   **[Biotech]** **Traversal Therapeutics executes $200 million PIPE financing** — *BioStocks* [Link](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2110702779350048788)
    *   Secured a $200 million private investment in public equity (PIPE) financing priced at $32.75 per share.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

*   **Kenya reports second Ebola case amid ongoing regional outbreaks** — *STAT* [Link](https://www.STATnews.com/2026/10/15/health-news-kenya-reports-second-ebola-case/?utm_campaign=rss)
    *   Kenya has confirmed its second case of Ebola, while the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains severe with over 4,000 deaths and 9,000 reported cases.
*   **Trump administration moves to authorize specialty peptide drug production** — *STAT* [Link](https://www.STATnews.com/2026/10/15/trump-administration-advances-plan-peptides-rfk-jr/?utm_campaign=rss)
    *   U.S. health officials are advancing a plan allowing specialty pharmacies to produce certain unapproved peptide injections favored by HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

- Biology & Health
    - [Could this Change Everything about Berberine and Heart Disease?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R0vufjzitPo) -- Physionic
        - References studies investigating berberine, including trial data, gene associations, and Mendelian randomization approaches regarding cardiometabolic diseases.
        - Examines sex-specific lipid, apolipoprotein B (ApoB), and lipoprotein(a) responses to berberine based on randomized placebo-controlled trials.
        - Explores the broader mechanistic and clinical impacts of berberine on lipid profiles and heart disease risk factors.
    - [Why Is Healthcare So Expensive?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/9XqNjYGhvUQ) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Questions the underlying mechanics of how healthcare functions and why costs are exceptionally high.
        - Examines whether the clinical outcomes delivered justify the heavy financial price of modern healthcare.
    - [Why This AI Business Still Needs Humans](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/IxNpSiC1xHo) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Features a business model built around processing and handling massive datasets.
        - Maintains a human-in-the-loop requirement at every stage of the AI pipeline.
- Pure Science
    - [When you lose weight where does it go?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6U6Z6pb6ewI) -- Veritasium
        - Poses the foundational question of what happens to bodily mass and where it goes when a person loses weight through working out or caloric restriction.
    - [What Does the Fourth Dimension Actually Look Like? | PODCAST: The Joy of Why](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kCh0ynBTyCg) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Discusses the concept of a fourth spatial dimension and why human intuition breaks down when trying to picture it.
        - Explains how mathematician Maggie Miller visualizes 4D spaces by treating them as a reel of three-dimensional snapshots.
        - Explores topological phenomena in four dimensions, noting that familiar 3D knots can always come undone in 4D, whereas ordinary surfaces like spheres can become knotted in ways that cannot be undone.
        - Details how Miller and her collaborators resolved a 1982 question posed by mathematician Charles Livingston regarding knotted surfaces.
    - [16 - Gangly #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Mk7o_lJ3v-Y) -- El Jj
        - The video features a brief spoken expression thanking an unspecified entity.
        - The content serves as a short installment of the #mathctober series titled "Gangly".
- Other
    - [What is Geothermal Energy?: Crash Course Geology #21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9-JFgpMIb_I) -- CrashCourse
        - Fossil fuels exist due to the power of the Earth, and that same terrestrial power can be harnessed as geothermal energy for a more sustainable future.
        - The episode covers the definition, formation processes, and environmental problems associated with fossil fuels.
        - The discussion introduces geothermal energy as an alternative power source derived from subterranean heat.
